shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs to Kick Goals Smoothly ⚽
shortIntro.para1: EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile (formerly FIFA Mobile) is a high‑action football game with detailed stadiums, real player animations, and immersive physics on mobile devices. If your device is underpowered, you might see laggy gameplay, delayed tackles, and stuttered ball control 🐢.
shortIntro.para2: Lower‑end phones can still play casual matches around ~30 FPS, while mid‑range and high‑end phones can reach smooth and responsive 60 FPS or even higher on supported hardware. Your goals and celebrations will look crisp and responsive ⚡🎉.

storageIntroText: EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile has detailed stadiums, real‑time lighting and animations — so you need ample storage for base install and updates:
faqIntroText: Common performance questions from mobile football fans 🥅:

faqList.question: Can I play EA SPORTS FC Mobile at 60 FPS?
faqList.answer: Yes — most devices reach ~60 FPS; some premium phones even support 90–120 FPS modes on supported hardware. 2

faqList.question: Why does my game lag mid‑match?
faqList.answer: Real‑time physics, complex stadium effects, and online interaction load CPU & GPU heavily — lowering graphics or FPS cap helps.

faqList.question: Does this require internet?
faqList.answer: Yes — the game needs an active connection for most modes, especially online matches and seasonal events.
